description: NaBa₆Nd(SiO₄)₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.45 Å. There are six inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.69-3.09 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.57-3.06 Å. In the third Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.70-3.28 Å. In the fourth Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-3.31 Å. In the fifth Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.92 Å. In the sixth Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.62-3.15 Å. Nd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-3.04 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 12°. There are two shorter (1.63 Å) and two longer (1.69 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 22°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.66 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. There is one shorter (1.64 Å) and three longer (1.66 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 20°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.71 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Ba, two equivalent Nd, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ba, one Nd, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Ba, two equivalent Nd, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Ba and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Ba, two equivalent Nd, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Ba and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, four Ba, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Na, four Ba, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Ba and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, four Ba, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Ba and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Na, four Ba, and one Si atom.
